fact: The council's first-half 2026 report lists the launch of a smart judicial assistant among achievements.
The IDSC policy perspective says AI projects are proceeding in governmental entities on health, water management and agriculture, with no tool stated in service.

Daily News Egypt reports NARSS, with the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, used remote sensing and artificial intelligence to inventory and classify crops by governorate, producing a 2023-24 winter crop map presented in November 2024.

Egypt Today reports the Ministry of Irrigation and Water Resources began a pilot in Kafr El Sheikh developing machine-learning algorithms that produce crop type maps from satellite images to guide irrigation water distribution.
